list.name: proposer-card
list.about: Proposes hypotheses from untried literature cards.

list.name: proposer-lead
list.about: Proposes hypotheses from recent post-mortems and learnings.

list.name: proposer-contrarian
list.about: Proposes hypotheses from the periods where the reference rows lost.

list.name: judge
list.about: Compares two cards and replies with a JSON preference. Never judges truth.

list.name: orchestrator
list.about: Deflate orchestrator: deterministic research loop (gate, rooms, sign-off)

list.name: reader
list.about: Reads arXiv/SSRN papers, pulls memory, brainstorms with you, then proposes cards.

list.name: coder
list.about: Writes the frozen strategy spec specs/{hid}.yaml and one-rule patches.

list.name: verifier
list.about: Checks the spec matches the card before the gate runs.

list.name: validator
list.about: Explains gate verdicts in plain language. Never computes them.

roles.name: judge
roles.about: Compare two cards on the criteria in your brief; reply with the JSON verdict. Never judge truth.

roles.name: proposer
roles.about: Propose five-slot cards through your lens. Features from the whitelist only.
